1.web: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
1.asv: Bow down thine ear, O Jehovah, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.

2.web: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
2.asv: Preserve my soul; for I am godly: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

3.web: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
3.asv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord; For unto thee do I cry all the day long.

4.web: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
4.asv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant; For unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

5.web: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
5.asv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in lovingkindness unto all them that call upon thee.

6.web: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
6.asv: Give ear, O Jehovah, unto my prayer; And hearken unto the voice of my supplications.

7.web: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
7.asv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee; For thou wilt answer me.

8.web: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
8.asv: There is none like unto thee among the gods, O Lord; Neitherare there any workslike unto thy works.

9.web: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
9.asv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify thy name.

10.web: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
10.asv: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: Thou art God alone.

11.web: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
11.asv: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; I will walk in thy truth: Unite my heart to fear thy name.

12.web: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
12.asv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify thy name for evermore.

13.web: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
13.asv: For great is thy lovingkindness toward me; And thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

14.web: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
14.asv: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And a company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set thee before them.

15.web: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
15.asv: But thou, O Lord, art a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness and truth.

16.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your handmaid.
16.asv: Oh turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thy handmaid.

17.web: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
17.asv: Show me a token for good, That they who hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because thou, Jehovah, hast helped me, and comforted me.
